headline: JetBlue Raises Checked Baggage Fees as Jet Fuel Prices Remain High
summary: JetBlue increased its fee for a first checked bag to $50 one way for most economy passengers, up from $39 previously, as high jet fuel prices persist.
why: Airlines adjust ancillary baggage fees to offset rising operational headwinds driven by sustained high jet fuel input costs.

impacts.name: JetBlue Airways
impacts.why: Raising baggage fees serves to offset high fuel input costs and protect passenger revenue margins.
